sql:
WITH a AS (SELECT state_fips, year, period, value FROM econ.regional_employment WHERE series LIKE '%05' AND year IN (2024,2025,2026)),
c AS (SELECT x.state_fips, x.year, x.period, x.value/y.value-1 AS yoy FROM a x JOIN a y ON x.state_fips=y.state_fips AND x.period=y.period AND y.year=x.year-1 WHERE x.year IN (2025,2026)),
r AS (SELECT year, period, state_fips, yoy, rank() OVER (PARTITION BY year, period ORDER BY yoy DESC) rk FROM c)
SELECT year, period, state_fips, round(yoy*100,2) yoy_pct, rk FROM r WHERE rk<=2 AND (year=2026 OR (year=2025 AND period>='M05')) ORDER BY year, period, rk

WITH a AS (SELECT substr(series,4,2) st, year, period, value FROM econ.state_industry WHERE series LIKE 'SMU__000000000000001' AND period LIKE 'M%' AND period<>'M13' AND year IN (2024,2025,2026)),
c AS (SELECT x.st, x.year, x.period, x.value/y.value-1 AS yoy, x.value v FROM a x JOIN a y ON x.st=y.st AND x.period=y.period AND y.year=x.year-1 WHERE x.year IN (2025,2026)),
r AS (SELECT year, period, st, yoy, v, rank() OVER (PARTITION BY year, period ORDER BY yoy DESC) rk FROM c)
SELECT year, period, st, round(yoy*100,2) yoy_pct, v, rk FROM r WHERE rk<=2 AND (year=2026 OR (year=2025 AND period>='M05')) ORDER BY year, period, rk

SELECT state_fips, round(value,1) ur FROM econ.regional_employment WHERE series LIKE '%03' AND year=2026 AND period='M05' AND state_fips IN ('32','11','06','53','41','26','17','10','09','37') ORDER BY value DESC

SELECT DISTINCT year, period, value FROM econ.state_industry WHERE series='SMU32000000000000001' AND ((year=2026 AND period IN ('M01','M02','M03','M04','M05','M06')) OR (year>=2022 AND value>=1600) OR (year=2025 AND period IN ('M05','M06'))) ORDER BY year, period

WITH a AS (SELECT DISTINCT substr(series,4,2) st, year, period, value FROM econ.state_industry WHERE series LIKE 'SMU__000000000000001' AND year IN (2025,2026) AND period IN ('M05')), r AS (SELECT x.st, x.value/y.value-1 yoy, rank() OVER (ORDER BY x.value/y.value-1 DESC) rk FROM a x JOIN a y ON x.st=y.st AND y.year=2025 WHERE x.year=2026) SELECT st, round(yoy*100,2) yoy, rk FROM r WHERE rk<=5 ORDER BY rk

sql: WITH a AS (SELECT DISTINCT substr(series,4,2) st, substr(series,11,2) ss, year, value FROM econ.state_industry WHERE series LIKE 'SMU__00000__000000001' AND year IN (2025,2026) AND period='M05' AND substr(series,11,2) IN ('05','50','60','65')), r AS (SELECT x.st, x.ss, x.value/y.value-1 yoy, rank() OVER (PARTITION BY x.ss ORDER BY x.value/y.value-1 DESC) rk FROM a x JOIN a y ON x.st=y.st AND x.ss=y.ss AND y.year=2025 WHERE x.year=2026) SELECT ss, st, round(yoy*100,2) yoy, rk FROM r WHERE st='32' OR rk=1 ORDER BY ss, rk
